selection: Lowest validation log loss; prefer simpler model within absolute 0.005 log loss, provided Brier difference <=0.002 and ROC-AUC difference <=0.01. Simplicity order baseline logistic, L2 logistic, L1 logistic, histogram boosting.
calibration: Stratify calibration partition 50/50 fit/selection. Compare none, sigmoid on logits, isotonic; prefer none then sigmoid within 0.002 selection log loss of best. Refit chosen calibration method on entire calibration partition. Base models remain training-only. Final test scored once after decisions frozen.
feature_ablation: Compare raw-only vs raw+seven engineered summaries plus ratio-availability indicator L2 logistic on validation; include engineered group only if log loss improvement >=0.002. No test feature selection.
raw_preservation: Original UCI archive and XLS unchanged; excluded from Git. Identifier used only for split audit, never predictor. Undocumented category codes retained separately.
test_policy: Alternative final-test comparisons are predeclared descriptive audit only; do not select/refit after seeing final test. Bootstrap intervals conditional on split and fitted model, not population or temporal uncertainty.
